description: Source code for decoding IA-32 (x86) operands in a disassembler, including functions for applying segment overrides, decoding operand values, and handling various operand types and addressing modes.

methods.name: apply_seg
methods.description: Applies segment override prefix to a memory operand based on instruction prefixes.

methods.name: decode_operand_value
methods.description: Decodes the operand value based on addressing method, operand type, and instruction context.

methods.name: decode_operand_size
methods.description: Determines the size and datatype of an operand based on operand type and instruction attributes.

methods.name: ia32_decode_operand
methods.description: Main function to decode an operand from a buffer, considering operand flags, prefixes, and addressing mode.
